_note: Anthropic does not publish its limits, so these are rough starting points, not measurements. They exist only so a fresh install has something to draw before it has read anything, and they are replaced the moment `claude -p "/usage"` reports a real percentage — which is almost immediately for anyone signed in to a subscription, and is then remembered, so these numbers stop mattering after the first busy window. They matter mainly to API-key users, who get no percentage at all. The Max figures are Pro scaled by the plan's own multiplier. `tokio calibrate <pct>` replaces them with your own. Anything derived from this file reaches the interface marked `basis: 'default'`, so a guess is never shown as a fact.
